notes: ASK A JUDGE (GAME > JUDGE, or a quick slot): a rules question for the game you are playing, answered by an AI in a few seconds
SPEAK opens the keyboard with the mic listening (up to 15 s, it waits through a pause); TYPE opens the keyboard
The ruling scrolls with the knob or a drag; the mic and keys at its foot ask the next one; reopening shows the last answer
It asks with the voice key (OpenAI), or Claude with anthropic.key, or any server in judge.txt -- one OpenAI key turns on the mic and the judge
The mic's text can now be 240 characters (was 96)
The wall clock on the face says am / pm: BASIC's TURN 1   8:22 read as a turn clock
